findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_number, request_vendor_number · Private data: number_history · Public sink: watch_number, request_vendor_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_number, request_vendor_number · Private data: number_history · Public sink: watch_number, request_vendor_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
